body:
## Problem

With `mcp==2.3.0`, `mcp-types==2.3.0`, and protocol `2026-07-28`, the official `@modelcontextprotocol/conformance@0.2.0-alpha.12` client scenario `sep-2322-client-request-state` sends a successful `tools/call` result without `resultType` to verify the client fallback to `complete`.

The modern strict union validator runs before any normalization. `ClientSession.send_request` raises `pydantic.ValidationError` (`CallToolResult.resultType Field required`, `InputRequiredResult.resultType Field required`), and clients using PydanticAI `MCPToolset` / FastMCP 4.1.3 exit 1. The conformance harness reports all 5/5 message-exchange checks PASS but marks the scenario **overall FAILED** because the client process exits nonzero.

## Reproduce

Use the official runner `0.2.0-alpha.12` with `--scenario sep-2322-client-request-state --spec-version 2026-07-28`; run a PydanticAI MCPToolset client that calls the scenario's `test_mrtr_echo_state`, `test_mrtr_unrelated`, `test_mrtr_no_state`, `test_mrtr_no_result_type` tools. The final call returns an omitted discriminator and triggers the exception in `mcp_types.methods.validate_server_result`.

## Expected

For an **inbound** modern result with no `resultType`, `inputRequests`, or `requestState`, default the discriminator to `complete` before strict per-version validation. Preserve explicit discriminator values, untagged pending-input envelopes, and legacy protocol behavior. Do not alter server output or the MCP profile.

## Evidence and proposed change

A 7-case SDK regression suite passes with this normalization. All four official scenarios driven through PydanticAI MCPToolset pass (2/2, 6/6, 9/9, 5/5 checks; process exit 0), and the full official Python SDK scored client baseline remains 32/32 PASS. Candidate fix: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk/pull/3766 (automatically closed pending this issue / maintainer assignment).
title: Client 2026-07-28: missing resultType causes ValidationError despite required complete fallback
